concerns.text: FR-006 requires the system to *terminate* the pipeline if total runtime exceeds the 6‑hour limit. Task T012 only records the runtime and checks a boolean flag, but does not enforce termination, thereby weakening the functional requirement.

Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) mandates a verification step for every external citation. No task in the list addresses citation verification or invokes the Reference‑Validator Agent, so the constitution is violated.
